description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' Request Context functionality, verifying the propagation of ambient data across grain calls within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: RequestContextTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Orleans request context propagation features.

methods.name: RequestContextCallerToCalleeFlow
methods.description: Tests that data set in the request context in the caller flows correctly into the grain operation.

methods.name: RequestContextCalleeToCallerFlow
methods.description: Tests that data set within a grain can flow back to the caller (though this flow is typically one-way and this test is currently skipped).
